label: Ho Chi Minh City
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels across Ho Chi Minh City, from Saigon riverside towers to District 1's business core.
intro: Ho Chi Minh City's hotels in this directory cluster around District 1 -- the city's commercial and nightlife center -- and the Saigon riverside, with a smaller number of properties further out near Phu Nhuan and the airport corridor. Traffic density makes proximity to District 1 the main practical factor in choosing a base.
